title: Model record
description: One model family member, unquantized. The id is the Hugging Face repo id verbatim, so the record lives two levels deep. Quantizations are child records under models/<owner>/<name>/quants/. File: models/<owner>/<name>/model.json

id.description: The Hugging Face repo id, verbatim and case-preserved: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, google/gemma-4-E2B-it. Equals the directory path under models/.
id.$comment: id and hf_id must be the same string. JSON Schema cannot compare two properties, so the validators (packages/core/scripts/check-registries.mjs, tools/validate, bench) enforce that.

hf_id.description: Hugging Face repo of the reference (usually BF16) weights. Must equal id — the id is this repo. The weights of a quantization live elsewhere; see quant.hf_id.
hf_id.$comment: No longer nullable: under this scheme a model that is not on the Hub has no id, and that would be a spec change rather than a null.

active_params_b.description: Active parameters per token in billions. Equals params_b for dense models; drives the bandwidth plausibility bound for MoE.

attention.description: "hybrid" = interleaved full/linear or SSM layers; matters for prefix caching support.
